purpose: Measure conditional Adam200 optimizability of random valid compact-flexible-v3 prior samples.

source.selection: 120 samples drawn uniformly without replacement with seed 20260904
source.reason_for_conditioning: Invalid initial states are measured screening outcomes and cannot start strict-continuation Adam.

optimizer.normalization_scale_source: frozen Flow checkpoint training-set coordinate standard deviations
optimizer.initial_geometry: preserved by unclipped affine coordinates and a per-start fixed current L1 reference
optimizer.direction_policy: fresh random orthogonal directions per update

resources.historical_runtime_basis: Balanced-v2 Adam200 measured p50 823.4 s, p90 1574.3 s, and maximum 4281 s per completed trajectory.

interpretation: Conditional Adam success is multiplied by the measured compact-flexible-v3 initial-valid rate to estimate unconditional prior abundance.
default_impact: none; qh-flow-screen32-adam200-64d-abi11-v1 remains the current default
